decisions.rationale: Lead Pelipper (Drizzle) to override Charizard-Y sun with rain, weakening Fire and supporting Water moves; pair with Archaludon (Sturdy Steel/Dragon) to wall Dragapult Dragon/Ghost and Venusaur Poison. Back Aegislash (King's Shield/Shadow Ball) to pivot against Skeledirge/Clefable, and Mega Medicham (Pure Power Fake Out/Close Combat) to break Garganacl and stop Follow Me. This uses our registered rain/steel core and mega punch plan.

decisions.rationale: Leading Charizard and Venusaur allows immediate weather control via Mega Charizard Y's Drought over Pelipper's Drizzle, enabling Venusaur's Chlorophyll speed and Sun-boosted Weather Ball/Earth Power to pressure Archaludon, Corviknight, and Aegislash. Dragapult provides fast late-game cleanup with Thunderbolt and Shadow Ball, while Skeledirge offers Unaware bulk and Fighting/Normal immunities against Medicham.
decisions.notebook: Matchup build carried from teambuilding. Plan: Stalwart Steelworks relies on rain synergy, fast physical pressure, and boost setup with Archaludon, Pelipper, Volcarona, and Mega Medicham. Mega Charizard Y and Chlorophyll Venusaur take weather control and break their Steel/Water core under Sun. Dual Unaware walls Skeledirge and Clefable shut down Quiver Dance Volcarona while providing Follow Me and Fighting immunities against Mega Medicham. Garganacl uses Wide Guard to block spread attacks and Salt Cure to chip Steel/Water types, with Dragapult providing fast speed control. decisions.rationale: Venusaur outspeeds all active foes under Sun (Speed 264) and Charizard (120) outspeeds Pelipper (85-117). Earth Power into Archaludon deals 64.5-124.2%, breaking Sturdy or heavily weakening it. Sun-boosted Heat Wave from Charizard follows up to secure the KO on Archaludon through Sturdy while chipping Pelipper for 33.5-67.4% before Pelipper can act.

Archaludon is 2x weak to Ground from both foes (Scorching Sands/Earth Power) and likely targeted; Protect (priority +4) activates first, stalling and possibly wasting their attacks. Speed: Archaludon Protect goes before all; Pelipper is slowest but safe if foes hit the protected Archaludon. Rain is already up, so no Rain Dance needed.

reflections.summary: Lost because the four brought were poorly suited: Pelipper’s rain is instantly replaced by Mega Charizard-Y’s Drought, Archaludon is Ground-weak and was stalled to death by failing consecutive Protects into Scorching Sands/Earth Power, Medicham held Medichamite but stayed Pure Power (never mega evolved), and Dragapult’s Focus Sash + Thunderbolt removed Pelipper while Skeledirge’s Unaware broke the wall. All four fainted by turn 7.
reflections.adjustment: For game 2 drop Pelipper and Archaludon from the four—rain is useless vs Drought and Archaludon cannot stall double Ground; bring Ground/Electric-resistant replacements. If Medicham is included, mega evolve on entry immediately (Huge Power). Stop chaining Protect against multi-target Ground—switch Archaludon out rather than stalling.
reflections.notebook: Opponent core revealed: Mega Charizard-Y (Drought, Scorching Sands spam), Venusaur (Chlorophyll, fainted), Dragapult (Focus Sash, Thunderbolt, Infiltrator, outspeeds Archaludon), Skeledirge (Unaware, Earth Power, Slack Off, Sitrus). Did not bring Garganacl or Clefable. Durable facts: rain is negated by Drought; Archaludon Sturdy only saves at full HP and fails vs Ground; Pelipper dies to Dragapult Thunderbolt; Medichamite was unused (Pure Power). Future plan: avoid rain-dependent previews vs sun teams; never leave Archaludon in against double Ground—switch, don’t Protect-stall; mega evolve Medicham on entry if brought; break Dragapult’s Sash with spread/priority rather than Dragon Tail.

reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Charizard Y and Dragapult provided immediate offensive pressure with Thunderbolt and Scorching Sands/Earth Power, breaking Archaludon and Pelipper despite losing Venusaur early to a rain-boosted Hurricane.
reflections.adjustment: Refine the lead and positioning so Venusaur is not exposed to Pelipper's Hurricane in Rain before Drought is secured, allowing Venusaur to capitalize on Sun speed.
